history.name: Bountysource
history.description_en: Former open-source bounty/crowdfunding platform; stopped paying claims in 2023 after its parent The Blockchain Group entered bankruptcy, and the site is offline.

claims.statement: Parent company bankruptcy Nov 2023; payouts stopped mid-2023
claims.quote: In November 2023, the Bountysource parent company announced it had filed for bankruptcy.

claims.statement: bountysource[.]com and app[.]bountysource[.]com do not respond

claims.quote: The Blockchain Group filed for bankruptcy in November 2023 ... in 2026 the domain does not resolve at all.

legacy_diffs: legacy "gone" confirmed with ≥2 signals (bankruptcy + domain unreachable)
history.notes: No operator shutdown notice; closure rests on bankruptcy filing + site offline.

qa.qa_value: bountysource[.]com now RESOLVES (89[.]116[.]147[.]161) and returns 403 Forbidden (not the old app)
qa.note: Closure stands on bankruptcy (independent). Note: rip[.]so "domain does not resolve" is now outdated — domain likely re-registered/parked
